intro: Technology leads the sectors affected by remote-code-execution vulnerabilities across 20 articles published between 2026-04-14 and 2026-10-23, with government, enterprise, software development, and telecommunications also represented. The coverage spans Global, Europe, North America, and United States regions, and includes CVE-2026-8836 at CVSS 10 alongside CVE-2026-41089, CVE-2026-41265, CVE-2026-45185, and CVE-2026-5760, each rated CVSS 9.8. Of the reported severity mix, 12 are critical and 7 are high.
